purpose: baseline of 0.8.0 (stored-result diagnostics; release gates use the interleaved A/B against the 0.7.0 source tree). Not accepted yet: repeatability failed one timing check, see verdict.repeatability
methodology: schema 2.2, Harness V3 (5 warm-ups, 3 x 7 batches, >= 50 ms per sample, median-of-medians), repeatability over 3 complete runs x the families of the run, interleaved A/B vs the 0.7.0 source tree (3 batches per side, alternating order), JVM side of the ffi gates from `gradle -p jvm :ace-native:ffiBenchmark`

verdict.repeatability: FAIL on 1 of 35 checks: macro.numeric_general.delta_variable.decompression_alloc spread 41.1 % over 3 runs (medians 9.03 / 12.42 / 8.71 ms, limit 15 %); 31 checks pass, 3 diagnostic. Deterministic values identical.
